# spaceman_node (Data Source)

A registered node, by ID or name (`GET /nodes`). Nodes are enrolled with a one-time token, which is never handled by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spaceman_node" "build" {
  name = "build-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/provider/docs_test.go -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The node ID (`nod_…`). Give `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) The node's unique name. Give `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `agent_version` (String) The agent's version, once it connected.
- `capacity` (Number) Runs the node accepts at once.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the node's agent is connected now.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `state` (String) `pending`, `active`, `disabled` or `revoked`.
